description: SLS v1.0.15 part 2: the unbounded R-ladder exit. Each mutation is a way the ladder could land somewhere the owner did not specify, be judged against a different target than the one it exits on, leak into the seal of every signal, be lost by the monitor, or be switched on without the stop it was measured with. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/m5_tp_ladder.json

a short's rungs are placed above the entry
mutations.old: return self.anchor + reach if self.direction == "UP" else self.anchor - reach
